statements.notes:
(Please read the entire label before use)
Recommended Use: As a dietary supplement, mix 1 scoop with 6-10 ounces of water or juice. To maximize results, drink 8-10 glasses of water daily.
Loading Phase: Day 1 through 5: Take 1 scoop 4 times daily.
Maintenance Phase: Day 6 forward: Take 1 scoop daily.
Warning: This product is only intended to be consumed by healthy individuals 18 years of age or older.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Consult your physician prior to use if you are pregnant or nursing. Consult your physician prior to use if you are taking any medications or have any medical condition.
Do not exceed recommended use. Improper use will not improve results. Discontinue use 2 weeks  prior to surgery. Do not use if safety seal is broken or missing.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store in a cool, dry place.
Contents are sold by weight not volume. Some settling may occur.
